title: Review rules sidecar
description: Shape of skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review-rules.json (embedded default layer) and of <repo>/.review-rules.json (project layer). Rules are evaluated in declaration order; the first matching glob wins within a layer; the project layer outranks the default layer.

include.description: Globs that bypass generated_path exclusion. Not a whitelist.

exclude.description: Globs never reviewed. Highest precedence among path gates.

generated_paths.description: Globs for vendored, generated, lockfile, and snapshot paths excluded by default.

coverage_quorum_threshold.description: Coverage rate below which a vendor is quorum-eligible only on files it reviewed.

rule.description: Checklist text rendered once per rule group.

merge_default.description: When true on a project rule, the matching default rule text is appended.
